# Results -- Study 259 (News-Tone) on real ^GSPC tape

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). Recipe: a curated
daily news-tone proxy (z-scored monthly headline-mood read, forward-filled to
business days) is matched to ^GSPC close-to-close returns; we ask whether today's
tone forecasts **tomorrow's** return. Position formed at today's close, held one
day (one-day execution lag). **The tone proxy is hand-curated in hindsight** --
any positive result is an upper bound, named on the Signal axis.
As-of **2026-06-17**.*

## Data stamp

| Source | Window | Shape | Fingerprint (last row) |
|--------|--------|-------|----------------------|
| yfinance ^GSPC daily (auto-adj, price-only) | 2007-01-03 -> 2025-12-31 | 4780 daily rows | `c3d8b303cf23` |
| Curated monthly tone proxy (hardcoded) | 2007-01 -> 2025-12 | 228 months | -- |

Returns are **price-only** (auto-adjusted); over a 1-day horizon the dividend
component is negligible, but the label is named for honesty.

## The seductive numbers (and why they are a trap)

| Test | Slope / Return | HAC *t* | R² / Sharpe |
|------|---------------|---------|-------------|
| Same-day fit (`ret ~ tone`) | +0.0020 | +5.42 | R²=0.016 (mechanical) |
| **Naive next-day fit (`fwd_ret ~ tone`)** | **+0.0021** | **+5.74** | R²=0.017 |
| Naive sign-timing strategy (gross) | **+35.0%/yr** | **+9.49** | SR=1.78, hit=55.4% |
| Naive sign-timing strategy (net @1bp + borrow) | +34.9%/yr | +9.46 | SR=1.77 |
| Buy & hold ^GSPC (benchmark) | +10.3%/yr | +2.65 | SR=0.52 |

At face value the tone signal *crushes* buy-and-hold: +35%/yr, *t* = 9.5,
Sharpe 1.8. That is the mirage.

## The two honesty checks that demolish it

| Check | HAC *t* | Verdict |
|-------|---------|---------|
| **Within-month demeaned next-day reg** | **+0.00** (R²≈0) | The entire edge is the month-level drift the hindsight proxy already "knew". Zero day-to-day forecast power. |
| **Prior-month tone, sign strategy** | **+0.97** (SR=0.19) | Give a trader only information knowable *before* the month begins and the edge vanishes -- indistinguishable from the market drift. |

The tone proxy is constant within each calendar month and was curated *knowing*
each month's outcome. So "tone predicts tomorrow" is really "this whole month
drifts, and every day inside it inherits that drift." Remove the drift
(demean) **or** remove the hindsight (lag one month) and the signal is gone.

## Sub-period analysis (naive mirage strategy)

| Period | Strategy/yr | HAC *t* | n days |
|--------|------------|---------|--------|
| 2007--2012 | +33.9%/yr | +4.11 | 1510 |
| 2013--2018 | +25.7%/yr | +5.69 | 1510 |
| 2019--2025 | +43.9%/yr | +7.00 | 1760 |

The naive strategy is "significant" in *every* sub-period -- which is exactly
what a hindsight artifact looks like. Stability here is a symptom, not a virtue.

## Turnover and cost

The monthly tone proxy flips sign only a handful of times per year, so turnover
is trivial: gross ≈ net (+35.0% vs +34.9%/yr). **Cost is not what kills this
idea -- hindsight is.** Costs are charged one-way × NAV on |position change|,
with short days paying a 0.04 bps/day borrow.

## Positive control -- the machinery finds predictability when planted

On the deterministic synthetic tape (`data.synthetic_daily`, gamma plants a
linear tone→next-day-return link):

| Planted gamma | Next-day reg *t* | Sign-timing Sharpe | Sign-timing *t* |
|--------------|------------------|--------------------|-----------------|
| 0.000 (null) | +1.25 | 0.31 | +0.90 |
| +0.002 | +9.79 | 2.59 | +7.29 |
| +0.004 | +18.32 | 4.78 | +12.46 |

The engine is truthful: it reads ~zero on pure-noise tone and lights up
monotonically when a real link is planted. The real-tape mirage is therefore a
property of the *data* (hindsight curation + within-month drift), not the code.

## Verdict

- **Signal -- NONE.** The headline next-day *t* = +5.74 is a hindsight artifact:
  within-month demeaning drives the slope to **exactly zero**, and the only
  information-respecting version (prior-month tone) reads *t* = +0.97,
  Sharpe 0.19 -- no day-ahead predictability whatsoever. The curated proxy can
  only *over*-state the effect, and even that dissolves. Verdict: **NONE**.
- **Tradability -- MIRAGE.** The only "profitable" version uses each month's
  mood *with hindsight* -- information no trader had in real time. The honest
  version is indistinguishable from buy-and-hold. Verdict: **MIRAGE**.
- **Proxy / look-ahead -- named.** The tone proxy is hand-curated in hindsight;
  all positive results are upper bounds. The honest tests remove the hindsight
  and the edge is gone.
